account: It is day 0, about 10:14, and I have arrived at the plaza for my scheduled market walk. The neighbour and three townsfolk are nearby. I have seen no emergency or confirmed damage. This morning the builder came to discuss this week's repairs and asked what work and payment I would authorize. There seemed to be confusion about whether my appointment book was a work order; I clarified that it was only my schedule. I tried to request an inspection and quote for bridge and road repairs, with no spending authorized, but only the secretary heard that request, so I cannot assume the builder received it. The secretary has taken the appointment book for safekeeping and said she would visit the dockside cottages to identify my tea host and report before tea. The schedule lists tea with the neighbour at 15:00 but gives no exact cottage. The neighbour now nearby may be able to clarify that. Otherwise, today's business appears routine: market walk, lunch at home at noon, town accounts at 13:00, tea at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I have no evidence of a hidden purpose behind these events.
